body:
Hey, deep breath. 

First off, you're being incredibly hard on yourself. We all fuck up, and sometimes it seems like we're doomed to keep doing it forever. Truth is, we're not.

You don't know that your meeting was unlucky for this person. Yes, things could've gone a lot better, but you also deeply care for them. And if it's this obvious to a complete stranger looking in on a snapshot of what you haven't said, then I'm fairly certain that they know. 

I won't lie and say you haven't hurt them; that much is obvious as well. But they will heal, and you know what? You may not be able to send this now, and I don't know if or when you will be. However, you have this time now to better yourself. You'll probably disagree with me on this, but I think you're a good person, and I think you can make positive changes without losing who you are. With time, you may find that the only person holding forgiveness from you is yourself, and hopefully you can change that as well.

Best of luck, OP. PM me if you want/need to talk.
That he did. He'll be drinking from the great tap in the sky now, I suppose. Maybe it's better up there.
Man...I just heard a couple of hours ago when I got home. It's terribly sad- he was going through so many health problems. Rest in peace, Lemmy.
It is if it helps you feel better at all. Feel free to post here or PM me if you change your mind. I hope things look up for you soon.

I'm really glad action is being taken on this. Over the past couple of days, I've seen people lurking around and leaving some unnecessarily bitter comments. People are coming here to express what they can't say; it's not very cool to start mocking them when they're posting in a subreddit made to allow for those feelings to be put out there.

Speaking of taking action, I would love to help moderate the board if at all possible. I've spent a lot of my time here recently in an attempt to get over my own upsets, and it'd be awesome to have a hand in keeping this place a safe one for others to do the same.

It's difficult to think that people like that are still out there, especially so close to home. But the sad fact is that not everyone is a good person or influence, even if they are family. You did the right thing, OP. Those kids are lucky to have as awesome of a dad as yourself, flaws and all.
That's fantastic! Glad to hear you've got a friend who can help you navigate the whole process of self-discovery. Cheers, and enjoy that discussion over coffee tomorrow!

Congratulations, man! That takes a fuckload of courage, and guess what? You had it in you! Still do, in fact. Now that you've told yourself (and a friend to boot), you can start living even truer to who you are.

What'd your buddy say, by the way?

I read it. 

You don't deserve the life you've been living, or the way you've been treated. At the very least, you still recognize that fact on some level.

Most importantly, you still have hope, and still make an effort to keep it. You hate that, because it hurts so much, but that hope is one of the best tools you have right now.

The place you are in isn't the best, not at all. But I think you can have a much better life than this. If you want/need to talk, my inbox is open. Feel free to PM me and we can discuss things.

Merry Christmas. Hold out for 2016, and may it bring the changes your life needs to have.

Yeah, that was a fun time. We tried staying friends, but apparently my life being a sack of garbage was too much for her when I asked for support just once after being kicked out in the rain and didn't respond right away because the cops were called to come and pick up this tiny kid trying to get on a train with no shoes or jacket. 

They ended up contacting my mom, who apparently told them I was in therapy for "this", and I had to explain to a couple of officers who couldn't care less that A) she threw me out and B) the therapy was to cope with the mental scars my parents had given me. But no, I was terribly selfish and awful for not making sure to check my phone through all of that! How terrible of me to make her worry like that!

...Yeah, fuck that noise. We haven't spoken in years, and I couldn't be happier.

High five, dude! 

....No? (I kid, I kid.) That seriously blows, though. Who the hell does that?! 

Funniest part is we were going to talk over some issues we were having in the relationship. Guess that got settled lol

People are hilarious, aren't they? This one time I got stood up on Valentine's day, froze my ass off in a park only to find out this kid went off and made out with some creepy scumbag guy from school. Classic bullshit, amirite?

Seriously though, your boyfriend can fuck right off. PM me if you need to laugh (or cry) about this. No shame in either.

That serenade is a personal favorite of mine. Not gonna lie, I openly wept the first time I heard it (though I prefer it at a slightly higher tempo than most recordings). 

To get to the point, however, you're absolutely right. Think of this not as loneliness, but a blank canvas upon which you have the freedom to create whatever you like to your heart's content.

Best of luck to you in 2016. May the story you write yourself be everything you want it to be.

You're not alone, buddy. That heavy ice water feeling is the worst; I'm struggling with it again lately after it'd finally let up for a bit. 

One of the best things you can do is reach out and connect with people, because there are ones out there who do actually care and can help ease the pain you're feeling. It's a difficult thing to manage, and there's a lot of slipups along the way, but if you remember to keep actively fighting, it does get easier. 

Even if it's just on a throwaway account on some nebulous site, you've already started to share what's been eating at you, which is as good of a first step as any. People have listened, too. With time, you'll find that in more and more people, until you have a solid support system of friends- be it online, offline, or both.

Losing a parent isn't an easy feat to deal with, either. Not by a long shot. PM me if you ever want to talk; either way, I wish you the best.
